plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to eliminate that risk.

conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, aiming for lower drawdowns. Expect slower growth due to reduced risk exposure.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to a small, manageable percentage.
Trim SPY and QQQ to reduce broad index concentration.
Buy SNOW, a top-rated scanner setup, to add growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth with a target of ~2.5% monthly return. It reduces concentration and leverage while adding a high-quality growth name. Drawdowns are expected to be moderate.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) for amplified gains.

Expect higher potential upside but also substantially larger drawdowns and amplified losses, especially with leverage decay.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and high-beta single names (CRWD).
Sell QQQ to remove growth-focused index exposure.
Significantly increase QQQI to maximize monthly income generation.
Trim SPY to a smaller allocation, prioritizing income over broad market exposure.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly return through steady distributions. It prioritizes income-generating assets like QQQI and minimizes volatile growth and leverage. Drawdowns are expected to be very low, but growth potential is also limited.
